what: Proposed malformed checks capture handling only logs stderr and leaves STEP5_CHK_STATUS empty
scenario_or_breakage: run_implement_loop ignores the checks helper exit code and keys entirely after parsing; if the capture contains no discriminator because the helper crashed or emitted only a shell error, the new total parser lets the loop proceed as if checks did not fail
suggested_fix: Keep the wrapper return 0 for set -e safety, but when no checks discriminator is present set STEP5_CHK_STATUS=fail and STEP5_CHK_FAILURE_REASON=malformed-capture so the existing stall path runs; add an integration-style parser test for that global state

what: The proposed required-field predicate omits RELEVANT_CHECKS_SKIPPED
scenario_or_breakage: A consumer repo without scripts/relevant-checks.sh validly emits RELEVANT_CHECKS_SKIPPED=true, but the proposed check would log required field missing for a non-failing terminal state
suggested_fix: Define the checks discriminator as STATUS or RELEVANT_CHECKS_OK or RELEVANT_CHECKS_SKIPPED, and add a skip fixture to the new parser section

what: The new parsers section is not wired into the sharded harness targets
scenario_or_breakage: CI and make lint use test-review-and-fix-dispatch and test-review-and-fix-convergence, while test-review-and-fix is a carve-out convenience target; the new regression can pass manually but never protect the canonical validation path
suggested_fix: Add test-review-and-fix-parsers, include it in a test-harnesses shard, update the PHONY list and nearby comment, and keep scripts/test-harness-shards-coverage.sh satisfied

what: The proposed lint parser fixture uses LINT_FIX_STATUS=ok, which is not a produced status
scenario_or_breakage: The parser test pins an impossible value while the runtime case statement only recognizes applied, main-agent-required, failed, and no-changes
suggested_fix: Use one or more real lint-fix statuses in the fixture, preferably applied for the happy path and the malformed case for missing status

what: The plan adds a new --section value but does not update the harness sibling contract
scenario_or_breakage: The script documentation will continue to claim only dispatch|convergence are supported, conflicting with the new CLI surface and the script-md sibling rule
